note: Supplementary check: full-text search on indications_and_usage instead of the structured purpose field. Purpose-field search is precise but 'Skin protectant' turned out to be a broad monograph bucket shared by eczema creams, diaper-rash cream, lip balm, and combo sunscreen products alike (see niche_analysis README). This search estimates how much of that bucket is actually eczema/seb-derm relevant, at the cost of being noisier itself (a cosmetic product can mention 'acne-prone skin' in marketing copy without being an acne drug).

eczema_sebderm_dandruff_indication_text_.query: eczema OR seborrheic dermatitis OR dandruff (deduped via OR)
